meta.title: Family doctor in Berlin-Wedding – Ärztezentrum Dr. Sharafi und Kollegen
meta.description: GP practice at Wedding, Berlin-Wedding. All statutory and private insurance, step-free access, online booking. We speak German, English and Arabic.

footer.em116: Outside opening hours: on-call doctor service

hero.alt: The practice waiting room with orange chairs, plants and a view of reception
hero.title: <l>Medicine built on trust.</l> <l>Personal. Skilled. Close by.</l> <sub>Your health is close to our hearts.</sub>
hero.lede: Our experienced team of doctors offers you personal care, modern diagnostics and comprehensive medical care – from check-ups to the treatment of chronic conditions.
hero.bookNote: Book through Doctolib in a few minutes. Your confirmation arrives by email.

services.title: Our services
services.intro: From a cold to long-term care: we handle much of it right here, with no detour to other practices.

care.title: Which check-ups are due for you?
care.intro: Enter your age to see which screenings and vaccinations statutory health insurance covers. If you have private insurance, please check with your insurer.
care.ageError: Please enter an age between 18 and 110.
care.note: Statutory insurance benefits and STIKO vaccination recommendations, updated 2026. Different intervals often apply if you have existing conditions, so please ask us. Your entry is not saved or sent.

care.count: At {age}: {count} recommendations – some only for women or only for men

checkupY.title: Health check-up
checkupY.detail: Once between the ages of 18 and 34.

checkup.title: Health check-up
checkup.detail: Every 3 years: consultation, examination, blood and urine tests.

bowel.title: Stool test for hidden blood
bowel.detail: Every 2 years from 50 – as an alternative to a colonoscopy.

colon.title: Colonoscopy
colon.detail: From 50, twice, at least 10 years apart.

cervix.title: Cervical cancer screening
cervix.detail: From 20; the interval depends on your age.

breast.title: Mammography screening
breast.detail: Every 2 years from 50 to 75, by invitation.

td.title: Tetanus and diphtheria
td.detail: Booster every 10 years, once combined with whooping cough.

covid.title: COVID-19
covid.detail: Every year in autumn. With certain medical conditions also at a younger age – please ask us.

lung.title: Lung cancer screening
lung.detail: For heavy smokers and former heavy smokers aged 50 to 75: a low-dose CT scan once a year. We'll advise you on whether you qualify.

mmr.title: Measles, mumps and rubella
mmr.detail: Once, if you were born after 1970 and aren't sure you're protected.
